verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection platform, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, an OpenAPI spec, SDKs, webhooks and .md doc mirrors; it never mentions an MCP server. Developer building blocks like the REST API and OpenAPI spec earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
